scientific_purpose: Disentangle writer content vs native retrieval using authentically measured historical physical PM2.5 magnitude, fitted SIDE-CAR ridge on frozen original 2-head LATFUSE008 trained checkpoints and source-real normalized recorded values; oracle, physically matched wrong and random source keys, fastslow/entity and legal present-source nuisance controls. Decision before any Option B neural architecture changes.

physical_source: Original UCI501 Beijing twelve genuine monitored stations, actual continuous PM2.5 in ug/m3 at recorded anchor, no synthetic label. Original source loader parses only original FIT numeric rows, prior train-only original strictly pre-2014-March normalization.
cohort_fit: Source-only deterministic high>=150 and ordinary<=35 ug/m3 same station/same hour matched pairs (max8/site) earliest from 2014-03-01 through 2014-03-30 exclusive, must have >=12 pairs, and last queried hour (anchor+512) BEFORE the earliest evaluation anchor. No model-score selection.

FIT-era evaluation originally seen in architecture design; no independent model/test qualification.

training_and_metric_protocol: Fit external DUAL ridge linear regression ONLY (not TAC-OSM training) separately per trained original model/lag/feature arm, fixed lambda=1.0, source TRAIN-only mean and variance of columns and of y=log1p(original physical PM2.5), feature clipping ±6 and scaling 1/sqrt(input dimension); source-only no evaluation fit/tuning. Score evaluation log1p-PM MAE, normalized train-target MAE, raw PM2.5 MAE with expm1 clamp, MSE, R² against train-only target mean, paired high-magnitude-vs-low ranking. Training min12 physical pairs, eval exactly24 physical pairs. Report all negative values.
primary_H64_go_B_query_gate: At original 64h: compared with wrong key and deterministic isotropic random key and fast/slow/entity control, oracle+source must reduce target log1p MAE by at least 5% relative to EACH control for BOTH checkpoint seeds, and original true source-station block-bootstrap95% interval of average paired absolute log-error improvement versus strongest competing control must have strictly positive lower bound. Correct oracle vs wrong signal evaluated on same target, no unlabeled geometry-only criterion.
nondecodable_interpretation: Gate failure does NOT prove content entirely absent: linear ridge external probe is limited, 24 paired source evaluation episodes tiny, parent TAC checkpoint trained on full original FIT includes May-June, natural timestamp and source weather confounds. If oracle fails source-grounded controls, do not train query-only B as sole proven fix; review writer value encoding/target-specific relevance as a separate registrable intervention.
future_B_registration: B0 genuine SOURCE-CONTENT RECONSTRUCTION ONLY; source-event binary + continuous real PM2.5 loss, no anchor value injected into legal read query, original alpha/beta writer held fixed. Train matched original-data fastslow nonassoc control with <=1% complete forward+AD+optimizer FLOPs and <=1% live params; same station+time source records, source split/optimizer seeds >=2, original 6800B recurrence and immutable checkpoint/clean replay. guards: Original measured historical target and oracle WRITE key used only for diagnostic probe, never passed to native deployed query. Original numeric 2015 exposed/2016-17 protected not parsed.
